title: Terraform private registry: module identifier case
assumptions: The synthetic HTTPS registry implements the responses reported in issue 16622.
Localhost and a fixture token replace the reporter's hostname and credential.
Versions 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 are chosen fixture data.
limitations: Does not verify a real boring-registry deployment, OpenTofu, or GitHub's hosted service.
Exercises the real Terraform parser, registry client, and latest-version check.
Ruby image tag and apt packages are not pinned to digests or snapshots.
